description: This file contains unit tests for the ChannelsSettings view in a SwiftUI application related to channel configuration and status snapshot handling. It sets up mock data, creates store instances, and verifies the building of UI bodies with and without snapshot data.

classes.name: ChannelsSettingsSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite that verifies the behavior of the ChannelsSettings SwiftUI view under different snapshot data conditions.

methods.name: makeChannelsStore
methods.description: Creates and initializes a ChannelsStore with predefined snapshot data for testing.
